headline: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
summary: Meta has open-sourced code for its new Muse AI agent. This allows users to create custom AI gadgets. Projects include E Ink displays or HDMI sticks for Muse.

headline: Netflix is pivoting away from prestige
summary: Netflix is ending multiyear deals with acclaimed directors like David Fincher. This signals a strategic shift away from prestige content. The move comes amidst increased competition.

headline: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
summary: Apple is adding new limits to Mac's "full disk access." This aims to counter risks posed by AI agents. Users will have more control over extraordinary access grants.

headline: Sling TV drops its one-day cable passes
summary: Dish-owned Sling TV is discontinuing its Sling Pass feature. The feature offered one-day, weekend, or week-long cable TV passes. It was initially announced last year.

headline: Love and Deepspace Devs Issue Warning to Players After Deadly Drink Recipes Go Viral
summary: Developers of Love and Deepspace warned players about fictional drink recipes. These recipes, if consumed in real life, could have disastrous consequences. The warning came after the recipes went viral.

headline: Capcom plans to transform RE Engine into an AI-generation game engine
summary: Capcom announced plans to evolve its RE Engine. The goal is to transform it into an "AI-generation game engine." Capcom aims for a future of creating games with AI.

headline: Former NFL Coach Mike Tomlin Is a Hardcore Minecraft Player
summary: Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin, Super Bowl LXIII winner, is also a dedicated Minecraft player. He revealed a massive Minecraft city he spent 12 years building. Tomlin has also become a Minecraft YouTuber.

headline: Best Buy: ASRock Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB Graphics Card in Stock for $740
summary: Best Buy currently has the ASRock Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU in stock. The graphics card is priced at $740. It offers performance nearly matching the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti for less cost.

headline: Widdecombe suspect charged with planning terror act against Farage
summary: A suspect has been charged with planning a terror act against Nigel Farage. Counter-terror police confirm the charge follows an intensive investigation. The details emerged from Widdecombe.

headline: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says
summary: Russia has struck Kyiv's Northern Bridge, according to the mayor. This follows recent repeated attacks on another major bridge in the city. The strikes target key infrastructure.

headline: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
summary: The G7 plans a coordinated release of millions of barrels of oil and diesel. This action aims to prevent further price spikes. The move also seeks to avoid a potential US diesel export ban.

headline: Woman deceived ex-partner about giving birth to his babies, judge rules
summary: A judge ruled a woman deceived her ex-partner about having his children. The man paid approximately £30,000 over two years believing he was a father. The deception involved faking births.
